gaps.missingEdge: The accepted T2 contract chain binds Kernel admission to a Refinery-produced packet via content_hash equality (RefineryPacketRef.content_hash == EvaluateInput.packetHash), but neither Refinery nor Kernel owns the canonical algorithm for deriving that hash from a RefineryPacket. SOT3-T6's integration package added a local `packetContentHash()` helper (canonical-JSON SHA-256 over stable RefineryPacket fields) strictly as caller-side type-mapping to satisfy this binding inside one bounded integration slice; it is not a shared, owner-level contract that other future callers can rely on.
